title: Answer: brains whose sensory areas process recurrently

statements.text: What is conscious is a brain in which sensory areas engage in recurrent processing, including people who cannot report what they see, such as an inattentive observer. A brain under anesthesia, with recurrence suppressed, sees nothing. Whether recurrence in very small circuits gives some experience is left open.

sources.quote: Lamme also discussed whether even RP between interconnected neuron pairs may perhaps generate some consciousness
